spiritgiven.comments: We felt that the repeated marking infractions (double teams) were persistent even after feedback, and there was no noticeable adjustment to this. We also had to call multiple violations which we felt stopped flow. This was consistent and occurred multiple times per point throughout. We felt stoppages were used to discuss tactics. Happy to discuss further if needed

For attitude: thank you for the apologies r.e. Sideline comments, however we do feel this plus reactions to calls warranted a lower score

For fair mindedness/ use of rules: relating to difference between contact willing to receive / give across the team, and as discussed we felt fouls were called whilst contesting for the same space when it advantaged you

spiritreceived.comments: Called 3rd timeout with out a timeout, and then called another timeout and then did follow the rules and increased count by 2, some increased body contact in second half, and felt like they did not listen to feedback.

There were multiple incidents where body contact was more than appreciated, but GB was really open to feedback throughout the game. 

We appreciate the fair mindedness of the whole team, making the right calls even when it was disadvantageous to them. :) <3

1.Fair-mindedness (Calling a double even when we are still far away from the disc)
2.Communication  (Sideline and supporters making unfriendly remarks, with no improvement even after communicating with the spirit captain)
